subject: Next steps 1 RTBF & data handling (FinServCo)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@finservco.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps 1 RTBF / data handling

Hi Samantha 1 thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps around the deletion/RTBF questions your DPO raised:

Summary of what we covered:
- Scope: customer-generated prompts, user-provided files, and model interaction logs (request/response) 1 these are treated as PII when they include personal identifiers per your policy examples.
- Data residency: we can pin FinServCo data to us-west-2 or a dedicated VPC region as needed.
- Deletion/RTBF flow: primary-store purge (application layer) -> metadata/indices update -> background compaction to free space.
- Backups & snapshots: backups are immutable by default and rotated; standard window is 30 days for disaster recovery.
- Audit logs: security/audit logs retained 90 days by default; we can discuss reducing this for compliance.

Immediate asks / proposed next steps:
1) I'll share our "data deletion playbook" (attached) that describes timelines and what we can commit to contractually.
2) Please confirm whether you need backup windows < 30 days and whether legal hold exceptions are expected.
3) If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min call with our Security lead to answer DPO-level questions and review evidence (SOC 2 scope, key rotations, KMS/HSM details).

Notes on timelines (high-level):
- Primary-store purge: typically initiated within 24 hours of a verified RTBF request and completed (object deletion + index updates) within 48 hours.
- Backups/snapshots: immutable backups may persist beyond the primary purge depending on your required recovery window 1 standard is 30 days, but we can shorten to 7/14/30 days via contract.
- Log/audit traces: retained 90 days; production tracing data used for debugging is paged out per our retention schedule.

Attachments: redwood-data-deletion-playbook.pdf, SLA-draft-FinServCo-v1.docx

Thanks 1 happy to jump on another call to align the exact contractual language.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com
(650) 555-0147

Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps 1 RTBF / data handling

Camila 1 thanks for the thorough recap. A few clarifying questions from the DPO and Legal team:

1) When you say "primary-store purge completed within 48 hours," does that include removing data from any training or fine-tuning datasets if we were to opt-in to model improvement? We need assurance that customer-supplied content can be excluded from training pipelines.
2) For immutable backups: under what conditions can we request an expedited purge, and what is the SLA for that? Our legal team prefers a 7-day maximum for backups where PII is present.
3) Audit/logs: is there an option to ship logs to our SIEM and then remove them from Redwood after an agreed retention? We also need to understand what gets redacted vs. what is full-text.

I'm attaching a short note from our DPO with sample contractual language to consider (dpo_questionnaire.pdf). Can your security lead join a technical call next week?

Best,
Samantha
Head of Product, FinServCo

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@finservco.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps 1 RTBF / data handling

Thanks Samantha 1 great questions. I answered inline below and added specifics we can put into the contract/addendum.

1) Training data / model improvement: By default, FinServCo data is NOT used for model training or improvement unless you opt-in. If you opt-in, we will segregate and exclude any datasets flagged for RTBF. We can include explicit contract language: "Customer data will not be used for model training without written consent from Customer."

2) Backups / expedited purge: Our standard recovery retention is 30 days. We can offer an expedited backup purge process (contracted add-on) with a target of 7 days for eligible objects. Note: immutable storage and cloud-provider snapshot behavior can introduce a short window where full physical deletion is constrained by provider snapshot semantics; we will commit to logical deletion (making data unrecoverable from application layer) immediately and physical purging per negotiated timeline.

3) Audit/logs & SIEM integration: We can stream audit logs to your SIEM (via secure delivery) and, upon confirmation of delivery and ingestion, remove corresponding logs from our platform earlier than the default retention. We also support field-level redaction for sensitive fields before log export.

Other details:
- Legal hold: If a legal hold is placed, our deletion process is paused; we will honor documented legal hold requests.
- Data residency: You can pin data to a specific region (e.g., us-west-2). For on-prem / VPC deployments there are additional onboarding steps and lead time.

Next steps I propose:
- Security deep-dive (30 min) with our Security/Privacy engineer (Marcus) and Product (Monica).
- Draft contract addendum language to cover: backup purge SLA (7/30-day options), training-data opt-out, SIEM log streaming & redaction clauses.

Are you available Tue 3/2 at 10:00am PT for the technical call? If that works I'll send calendar invites and include the security checklist link.

Thanks,
Camila

- Training data: by default, customer data is isolated and not included in opt-in training pipelines. If you later opt-in, we maintain dataset-level controls and can exclude flagged RTBF objects.
- Backup purge SLA: we can support a contracted 7-day logical purge for backups (with provider-dependent physical deletion caveat in the addendum).
- SIEM streaming: supported; we will provide an S3/HTTPS push target and use signed transfer with field-level redaction pre-export.

I'll share the security checklist and SOC 2 evidence pack on the call and post-meeting. Camila 1 I'll also prepare suggested contract language for the backup purge and training-data opt-out.
